note: National Bank of Oman's key facts statement for its Gold credit card: 21 rials a year, VAT included, with interest of 1.5% a month on a card held against salary; the 1.66% on a card against a pledged deposit isn't written, the game holding no pledged deposit. Bank Muscat's tariff gives its cards' fees but not their interest.

sources.title: National Bank of Oman, Key Facts Statement (KFS): Credit Card – Gold
sources.said: Key Facts Statement (KFS) Credit Card – Gold ... Annual Fee OMR 21 ... Interest Rate against salary 1.5% per month ... Interest Rate against Deposit 1.66% per month ... are inclusive of Value Added Tax (VAT)
